about: Screen parity fixture: cases run through the evaluator's app/screen.py at 5e907cf8, on a made-up rule file: the evaluator's hand lists at that commit (char_folds merged into char_map, as build_screen_rules.py does) and a few made-up names. Cases: the 4029 cases of screen-parity.f9becf64.json (every vector and sequence step, both adversarial sets, seeded fuzz) and 1000 seeded cases aimed at the newer rules (a cue, gap words, then a link or a mark; values before an as-link; user and password pairs; joined -p flags; PIN cues; algorithm and setting names, dotted paths and env var references; cue and assignment overlaps). Each case's ids names a list in snapshots. Regenerate with the parity harness, not by hand.
